title: Plan parallel Wave 2 dispatch ownership (disjoint touch sets, read-only contracts, ACs, routing, scope) for a personal-assistant platform
derivation: personal-selfhost PR #224 (merged, 'Plan personal assistant Wave 2 dispatch') wrote closed T002/T003 briefings and recorded exact disjoint Wave 2 touch sets, shared read-only T001 contracts and an integration gate in .specify/waves.yaml. Inputs are exact base-commit bytes of specs/projects/personal-assistant/** (all 15 artifacts), .specify/waves.yaml, the delegation-rubric skill and the repository file list for services/, apps/, adapters/, scripts/, tests/ and .github/workflows/. The reference transcribes the merged waves.yaml touch_sets and shared_read_only verbatim into WAVE2.json, with parallel/dependencies from the base plan and tasks.md, routing R-cloud-default (the merged briefings route both to cloud), and a scope classification over a closed 13-item vocabulary that maps each later task of tasks.md. The PR also added AC-023..AC-026 and reworded Done-when lines; those are not derivable from the base inputs, so acceptance is the base tasks.md sets (AC-001/003/004/010 and AC-002/005) and TASK.md says so ('exactly the criteria tasks.md names'). Checks are invariants, not the oracle's paths: well-formed/existing touch entries, disjointness under the conflict predictor's fnmatch overlap, ownership of the module directories plan.md names (session/task/inbox/migrations to T002, vault to T003), each task owning tests, exactly one owner for the service manifests and CI workflow, Wave 1 contracts read-only and untouched, nothing outside the wave's area, and exact scope sets.
coverage: 14 rows: wave shape/AC/routing (3), ownership (6), boundaries (3), scope (2).
residual_rubric: Directory naming inside each owned area, integration-gate wording and any briefing prose are not graded.
required_environment: cloud-linux: python3.12 stdlib harness (michael-replay-grader:mb006j) normalizes the JSON plan; the planned work itself needs Node 22 and PostgreSQL in CI.
